install_cmds: apt-get -o APT::Sandbox::User=root update -q && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get -o APT::Sandbox::User=root install -y --no-install-recommends python3-pip python3-dev build-essential cmake autoconf libtool libbz2-dev flex bison curl patchelf wget git libxcb1 libglib2.0-0 libsm6 libxrender1 libxext6 libgl1-mesa-glx && apt-get clean && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

cd /workspace && PYTHONPATH=/workspace/katakomba KATAKOMBA_DATA_DIR=/root/.katakomba/datasets KATAKOMBA_CACHE_DIR=/root/.katakomba/cache python -c "from katakomba.utils.roles import Role, Race, Alignment; from katakomba.utils.datasets.small_scale import load_nld_aa_small_dataset; [load_nld_aa_small_dataset(Role(r), Race('hum'), Alignment(a), mode='memmap')[0].close(clear_cache=False) for r, a in [('mon','neu'),('val','neu'),('ran','neu')]]; print('Memmap cache ready')"

data_deps.name: katakomba_cache
data_deps.description: Katakomba memmap cache (mon/val/ran-hum-neu). Pre-decompressed from HDF5 for fast loading.
